shortDescription: Create and manage ssh keys on the Hetzner Cloud.

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_endpoint_hetzner
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner API. You can also set this option by using the C(HETZNER_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: The token for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: fingerprint
options.description: The Fingerprint of the Hetzner Cloud ssh_key to manage. Only required if no ssh_key I(id) or I(name) is given.

options.name: force
options.description: Recreate the SSH Key if the public key does not match the one in the API.

options.name: id
options.description: The ID of the Hetzner Cloud ssh_key to manage. Only required if no ssh_key I(name) is given

options.name: name
options.description: The Name of the Hetzner Cloud ssh_key to manage. Only required if no ssh_key I(id) is given or a ssh_key does not exist.

options.name: public_key
options.description: The Public Key to add. Required if ssh_key does not exist.
